Ethereum is a public blockchain that supports smart contracts. Ethereum uses proof-of-stake as its consensus mechanism since its 2022 upgrade known as The Merge. Ethereum has a native cryptocurrency called ether (ETH).

Ripple (XRP) is a digital asset native to the XRP Ledger. Ripple (XRP) runs on the XRP Ledger, which is a public blockchain. Ripple (XRP) relies on a consensus protocol rather than proof-of-work mining.

DAI is a decentralized stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. DAI is overcollateralized by crypto assets locked in smart contracts. DAI is issued through the Maker Protocol.

Polygon is a scaling framework built on top of Ethereum. Polygon is compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine. Polygon offers a proof-of-stake sidechain for transactions.

USDC is a fiat-collateralized stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the US dollar. USDC is issued by Circle, which is a centralized company. USDC is backed by cash and short-dated US Treasury holdings.
